facts.text: A stone building with an inscription above the doorway was photographed. The owner assumed it is the old Manor House but this is not confirmed.

Village board attributes the Manor House to the Elmes family (16th or early 17th century), replacing an older manor of Sir George Kirkham opposite the north end of Church Lane. Do not attach this to the photographed building until it is confirmed.
Private residence. Observe from the public route only. No doorstep task and no looking inside.
